title.narrative: OUTPUT 2.7: REGIONAL MULTISECTORAL PROGRAMMING

description.narrative: Country Offices receive high-quality, timely, and context-specific technical assistance through regional donor-specific funding initiatives that strengthen equitable and resilient national health, nutrition, and Early Child Development (ECD) systems, enabling focused and scalable impact for children. Effective regional coordination on migration strengthens cross-border collaboration, ensures coherent support to Country Offices, and fosters a unified approach to advocacy and partnerships across the region.
